title: GitHub Repos, Users & Issues Scraper
description: Scrape public GitHub repository and organization/user metadata via the official GitHub API. Start with one repo or user; add a token only for larger runs.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Repositories as "owner/repo" (e.g. "openai/openai-node") or full GitHub URLs.

searchQueries.title: Repository Search Queries
searchQueries.description: GitHub repository search queries (e.g. "web scraper language:python").

includeIssues.title: Include Issues
includeIssues.description: If enabled, recent issues (and PRs) are nested in each repository record.

maxIssuesPerRepo.title: Max Issues Per Repo
maxIssuesPerRepo.description: Maximum issues to extract per repository.

includeUserRepos.title: Include User Repositories
includeUserRepos.description: If enabled, a user's repositories are nested in each user record.

maxReposPerUser.title: Max Repos Per User
maxReposPerUser.description: Maximum repositories to list per user.

maxResults.title: Max Repositories
maxResults.description: Maximum repositories to scrape in total across the explicit repo list and search queries. Use 1-5 for a quick test.

githubToken.title: GitHub Token (optional)
githubToken.description: A GitHub personal access token raises the rate limit from 60/hour to 5000/hour. Create one at github.com/settings/tokens (no scopes needed for public data).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Keep disabled for normal API runs; a GitHub token is the preferred way to raise rate limits.
